summary: The documented way to iterate is a normal multi-turn `generateContent` conversation: append the model's previous image part and your new instruction to `contents`. The model keeps visual context across turns.
combines: On Gemini 3 image models this depends on thought signatures, so echo the model's returned parts back verbatim including `thoughtSignature`. Stripping them breaks continuity.
`gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image` is explicitly called out as not optimized for multi-turn sequential editing.
Every generated image carries a SynthID watermark, on every model and every turn.
